Prettier Settings, search and note icons

Each row: today, Stitch, and Claude, with desktop and phone side by side. Click any picture to enlarge it. Cosmetic only: the same features and keys. Claude's version is also live at docs/design/polish/claude.html (the switches work).

1 · Notes with colourful emoji icons

Stitch invents extras (breadcrumb, sticky memo, tabs) and drops the notebooks under Projects. Claude keeps your panel as it is and adds the emoji tiles, a big emoji above the page title and an icon picker.

2 · Search results

Both show the emoji, a highlighted title and line of text, the notebook and the time. Claude adds a preview of the selected note and a "by meaning" tag. Stitch's phone version cuts the titles off ("Lisb…"), which needs fixing.

Stitch

Claude

3 · Settings

Both turn Settings into a proper window with a section list and real switches. Stitch: soft pastel icon tiles, a search box, a dark selected row. Claude: solid colour tiles like macOS, with the open note's properties moved out to the title.
